geometry.grading_mapping: sampled per-vertex quality.spec plus independent whole-edge constraint and midpoint refinement
geometry.offset_polygon: intersection of hull-normal and 128 uniform-angle support halfplanes
geometry.refinement_seeds: all prior vertices plus midpoints of violating edges; lexicographically unique

probes.filling: expand to remaining observations; never duplicate probe identities
probes.coverage: farthest point from all previously selected probes; raw source row breaks ties
probes.gap_diagnostic: endpoints of deterministic Euclidean MST edges longer than 5 times median 20-NN radius; diagnostic only
